exposure: Prophylactic intraoperative abdominal aortic balloon occlusion (IAABO)
Placenta previa (PP) and/or placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) status
prophylactic intraoperative abdominal aortic balloon occlusion (IAABO)
finding: IAABO during cesarean section in pregnancies with PP and PAS did not significantly reduce blood loss or transfusion rates compared to the PP + PAS group and was associated with increased risks of complications like uterine artery embolization and hysterectomy.
